name: Combined Hamartoma of the Retina and Retinal Pigment Epithelium
aliases: Combined Hamartoma of Retina and RPE
Retinal and Retinal Pigment Epithelium Hamartoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Combined Hamartoma of Retina and RPE

criteria.description: Presence of a grayish elevated retinal lesion with associated retinal vascular tortuosity on fundoscopic examination
OCT demonstrating retinal thickening with disorganization of inner retinal layers and hyperreflective lesion involving retina and RPE
Fluorescein angiography showing mild leakage and vascular tortuosity without neovascularization
Presence of visual acuity reduction or visual field defects corresponding to lesion location

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic fundus lesion with confirmatory OCT findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by multimodal imaging; biopsy is rarely performed.

imaging: Fundus photography showing elevated grayish lesion with vascular tortuosity
Optical coherence tomography (OCT) revealing retinal thickening and disorganization
Fluorescein angiography demonstrating mild leakage without neovascularization
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; sporadic cases predominate
other: Histopathology (rarely performed) shows disorganized retinal and RPE tissue with glial proliferation

distinguishingFeatures: Different fundus appearance without vascular tortuosity
Flat pigmented lesions without retinal thickening
No inner retinal disorganization on OCT

references: Gass JD. Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium. Arch Ophthalmol. 1973;90(3):270-278.
Shields CL, et al. Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium: clinical spectrum and management. Ophthalmology. 2005;112(6):1057-1064.
Orphanet: Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium. ORPHA:440727.
